mapper.sql: purchase_requests.id AS id, purchase_requests.pr_code AS poNo, purchase_requests.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, purchase_requests.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, vendors.email_address AS email, purchase_requests.order_date AS poDate, purchase_requests.vendor_contact_id AS vendorContactId, vendor_contacts.contact_name AS vendorContactName, purchase_requests.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, purchase_requests.note AS note, purchase_requests.final_place_of_delivery_id AS deliveryTo, location_groups.name AS deliveryToName, purchase_requests.delivery_leadtime AS deliveryLeadTime, purchase_requests.ref_quotation AS refSaleOrder, purchase_requests.payment_id AS paymentTermId, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName, purchase_requests.shipment_id AS shipmentId, shipments.name AS shipmentName, purchase_requests.ship_to AS shipTo, ship_to.name AS shipToName, purchase_requests.contact_ship_to AS contactShipTo, contact_ship_to.contact_name AS contactShipToName, purchase_requests.port_of_dischange_id AS partOfDischargeId, port_of_dischange.name AS partOfDischargeName, purchase_requests.port_of_dischange_contact_id AS partOfDischargeContactId, port_of_dischange_contact.contact_name AS partOfDischargeContactName, purchase_requests.expected_delivery_date AS expectedDeliveryDate, purchase_requests.total_amount AS subTotal, purchase_requests.vat_setting_id AS vatSettingId, vat_settings.name AS vatSettingName, purchase_requests.total_vat AS totalVat, purchase_requests.vat_percent AS vatPercentage, purchase_requests.is_close AS isClose, purchase_requests.status AS status, purchase_requests.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, purchase_requests.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM purchase_requests LEFT JOIN companies ON purchase_requests.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN vendors ON purchase_requests.vendor_id = vendors.id LEFT JOIN vendor_contacts ON purchase_requests.vendor_contact_id = vendor_contacts.id LEFT JOIN vendors AS ship_to ON purchase_requests.ship_to = ship_to.id LEFT JOIN vendor_contacts AS contact_ship_to ON purchase_requests.contact_ship_to = contact_ship_to.id LEFT JOIN vendors AS port_of_dischange ON purchase_requests.port_of_dischange_id = port_of_dischange.id LEFT JOIN vendor_contacts AS port_of_dischange_contact ON purchase_requests.port_of_dischange_contact_id = port_of_dischange_contact.id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON purchase_requests.currency_center_id = currency_centers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON purchase_requests.final_place_of_delivery_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON purchase_requests.payment_id = payment_terms.id LEFT JOIN shipments ON purchase_requests.shipment_id = shipments.id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON purchase_requests.vat_setting_id = vat_settings.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = purchase_requests.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = purchase_requests.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(purchase_requests.id) FROM purchase_requests INNER JOIN `vendors` ON purchase_requests.vendor_id = vendors.id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = purchase_requests.currency_center_id
SELECT ref_doc AS url, ref_doc_name AS name FROM purchase_requests WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_requests ( company_id, vendor_id, vendor_contact_id, pr_code, delivery_leadtime, exchange_rate_id, currency_center_id, ref_quotation, shipment_id, payment_id, ship_to, contact_ship_to, port_of_dischange_id, port_of_dischange_contact_id, final_place_of_delivery_id, expected_delivery_date, total_amount, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, order_date, note, ref_doc, ref_doc_name, created, created_by, is_close ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrder.companyId}, #{purchaseOrder.vendorId}, #{purchaseOrder.vendorContactId}, #{purchaseOrder.prCode}, #{purchaseOrder.deliveryLeadTime}, #{purchaseOrder.exchangeRateId}, #{purchaseOrder.currencyCenterId}, #{purchaseOrder.refQuotation}, #{purchaseOrder.shipmentId}, #{purchaseOrder.paymentId}, #{purchaseOrder.shipTo}, #{purchaseOrder.contactShipTo}, #{purchaseOrder.partOfDischargeId}, #{purchaseOrder.partOfDischargeContactId}, #{purchaseOrder.finalPlaceDeliveryId}, #{purchaseOrder.expectedDeliveryDate}, #{purchaseOrder.totalAmount}, #{purchaseOrder.totalVat}, #{purchaseOrder.vatPercentage}, #{purchaseOrder.vatSettingId}, #{purchaseOrder.orderDate}, #{purchaseOrder.note}, #{purchaseOrder.refDoc}, #{purchaseOrder.refDocName}, NOW(), #{purchaseOrder.createdBy}, #{purchaseOrder.isClose} )
mapper.select: SELECT purchase_request_orders.order_id AS id, orders.order_code AS code FROM purchase_request_orders LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.id = purchase_request_orders.order_id WHERE purchase_request_orders.purchase_request_id = #{id}
SELECT small_val_uom FROM products WHERE id = #{productId};

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, purchase_request_details.id AS id, purchase_request_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS itemCode, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, purchase_request_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(purchase_request_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, purchase_request_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_request_details.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_request_details.note AS note FROM purchase_request_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = purchase_request_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_request_details.purchase_request_id = #{id} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, purchase_request_services.id AS id, purchase_request_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS code, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, purchase_request_services.qty AS qty, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, purchase_request_services.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_request_services.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_request_services.note AS note FROM purchase_request_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = purchase_request_services.service_id WHERE purchase_request_services.purchase_request_id = #{id} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_request_details ( purchase_request_id, product_id, note, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion, total_cost, unit_cost ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrderDetail.purchaseRequestId}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.productId}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.note}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.qty}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.uomId}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.conversion}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.totalCost}, #{purchaseOrderDetail.unitCost} );

INSERT INTO purchase_request_services ( purchase_request_id, service_id, note, qty, total_cost, unit_cost ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrderServices.purchaseRequestId}, #{purchaseOrderServices.serviceId}, #{purchaseOrderServices.note}, #{purchaseOrderServices.qty}, #{purchaseOrderServices.totalCost}, #{purchaseOrderServices.unitCost} );

INSERT INTO purchase_requests ( company_id, pr_code, vendor_id, vendor_contact_id, exchange_rate_id, currency_center_id, ref_quotation, shipment_id, payment_id, ship_to, contact_ship_to, port_of_dischange_id, port_of_dischange_contact_id, final_place_of_delivery_id, expected_delivery_date, total_amount, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, order_date, delivery_leadtime, note, ref_doc, ref_doc_name, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrder.companyId}, #{purchaseOrder.prCode}, #{purchaseOrder.vendorId}, #{purchaseOrder.vendorContactId}, #{purchaseOrder.exchangeRateId}, #{purchaseOrder.currencyCenterId}, #{purchaseOrder.refQuotation}, #{purchaseOrder.shipmentId}, #{purchaseOrder.paymentId}, #{purchaseOrder.shipTo}, #{purchaseOrder.contactShipTo}, #{purchaseOrder.partOfDischargeId}, #{purchaseOrder.partOfDischargeContactId}, #{purchaseOrder.finalPlaceDeliveryId}, #{purchaseOrder.expectedDeliveryDate}, #{purchaseOrder.totalAmount}, #{purchaseOrder.totalVat}, #{purchaseOrder.vatPercentage}, #{purchaseOrder.vatSettingId}, #{purchaseOrder.orderDate}, #{purchaseOrder.deliveryLeadTime}, #{purchaseOrder.note}, #{purchaseOrder.refDoc}, #{purchaseOrder.refDocName}, NOW(), #{purchaseOrder.modifiedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_requests WHERE YEAR(created) = YEAR(NOW()) AND pr_code LIKE '%PO%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(value,1) FROM uom_conversions WHERE from_uom_id = #{uomId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
